qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Strong cash generation in the Baltic mobile oligopoly is diluted by the larger Swedish market, where intense competition against Telia, Telenor, and 3 constrains pricing power below inflation and keeps multi-year ROIC (~8-10%) below the 12% cost-of-capital threshold.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3b (ROIC ~8-10% < 12%, pricing power below inflation, REJECT). While Tele2 operates a lean telecom challenger model with strong Baltic cash generation and Iliad backing, Swedish mobile and broadband competition restricts real pricing power and keeps multi-cycle capital returns below the 12% hurdle.
qualitative.evidence: Reported ROCE was 8% in 2021, 11% in 2022 (inflated by Netherlands divestment gain), 10% in 2023, and 11% in 2024, with multi-year GAAP ROIC running at 8-10%, failing Gate 3b. Net debt to EBITDA remains ~2.3-2.5x with substantial ongoing 5G network capex required to maintain competitive parity.
